verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships built-in event-driven automation: alerts and email notifications when tests fail, follow-up tasks auto-created from access reviews and synced to ticketing tools, and configurable recurring reviews by risk level with Jira and Slack tasks and notifications. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rules or workflow engine where users set their own triggers and actions; the configurable parts are limited to notifications, schedules and integrations. Missing for 10: a user-authored trigger→action rules builder, custom event triggers beyond preset ones (failing tests, reviews), arbitrary action types or webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
